overviewDescription: Spacing helps create consistent rhythm, hierarchy, and alignment across layouts and components.
marginDescription: Margin tokens that map directly to the SGDS spacer scale for consistent element offset.
paddingDescription: Padding tokens for internal component spacing and page-level layout regions.

principles.title: Alignment
principles.body: Use consistent spacing to align elements and support the layout structure.

principles.title: Flexibility
principles.body: Let spacing adapt across screen sizes while keeping layouts balanced.

principles.title: Uniformity
principles.body: Use the spacing scale consistently so layouts stay predictable.
